description: A door or window in a wall. offset = mm from the wall's start point to the opening's centre (get the wall's start/end/length from list_elements). Windows take a sill height (mm above the floor); doors stand on the floor. flip turns it to face the other side (door swing); hand puts the hinges on the right. Fails with the allowed range if it doesn't fit or overlaps another opening, unless clamp is true. Types: list_catalogue.

hand.description: Hinges on the left (default) or right, seen from the side it opens to

name: place_opening
title: Place door or window
